claims.head: Something has to give
claims.body: The Rangers are near the top of the league for chance quality, but the Kings are one of the best at preventing dangerous shots. We’ll side with the Kings’ defense.
claims.call: The Kings keep the Rangers’ chances less dangerous than the league average (a 6.3% chance of scoring on the average shot).

claims.head: Zibanejad’s line gets the soft minutes
claims.call: The Rangers’ L1 (Perreault, Zibanejad and Lafrenière) spends at least 42% of its 5-on-5 time against the Kings’ third line.
claims.body: At home, the Rangers keep sending Zibanejad’s line (Perreault, Zibanejad and Lafrenière) out against opponents’ third lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Mike Sullivan has been chasing an easier matchup for the team’s scorers. Tonight the Kings’ third line is Moore, Laughton and Armia.

notes.text: The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 9 games cover only 32% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the 10th-lowest in the league (a typical team: 44%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Kevin Fiala is on injured reserve (lower-leg surgery) and has not played this season. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
Alex Turcotte is on injured reserve and has missed the last 6 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Quinton Byfield is day to day and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-six forward. Alex Laferriere has taken his spot beside Adrian Kempe and Artemi Panarin.
Mats Zuccarello is out (upper body injury), reported after he played in their last game.
Jared Wright was added to the roster on Oct 16 and has played beside Corey Perry and Samuel Helenius.

NYR.head: The Rangers start a half-step ahead
NYR.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Los Angeles may be without Byfield, while the Rangers have home-ice advantage. Still, it’s close: the Kings can make it interesting if they keep shots to a minimum.

items.text: Pavel Dorofeyev has nine goals in eleven games against Los Angeles since 2023-24, most of them with Vegas.
The Kings are newly without Quinton Byfield and Mats Zuccarello, have been without Alex Turcotte since Oct 6, and have had to make do without Kevin Fiala all season.
